title: Delete a message
summary: Asks once, then deletes a message for everyone in the chat. The message becomes a deleted row (timeline-rows). An unsent own message is dropped without the question.

confirmRowId.description: The message the dialog asks about. Missing while the dialog is closed.

isDeleting.description: true while the deletion is sent.

error.description: true after a failed deletion. Shows bipe_app_message_delete_failed once.

askDelete.effect: Opens the dialog. For an own message that is not sent yet (sending or failed), skips the dialog and cancels the send.

confirmDelete.effect: Deletes the message for everyone, closes the dialog. The row turns into a deleted row at once.

notes: canDelete: own message and RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserRedactOwn, or another person's message in a group and RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserRedactOther. In a DM nobody deletes the other person's messages (ADR 0141: no moderation in a DM).
No reason is sent with the redaction.
Delete for me only is not a Matrix feature and is not offered. Deleting the whole DM is dm-delete, a separate flow.
redactionSendState of the item shows the deletion as pending until the server has it; a failure brings the message back and sets error.
